title: Minigame: C9 Mortars

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the C9 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): the fewest counters C9.1, C9.2, C9.4, and A21.13 need, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): set up g-squad with a 50mm light mortar [2-13], and Russian targets at range 1 and 2. Stack g-leader and g-second at ground level in [B10] on board bd03, with the second light mortar and the catalog campaign-german-81mm-mortar. The 81mm is manned by g-leader, facing west, with a Russian target in [B6]. Start in the PFPh. Compare g-leader firing alone with g-second participating in a separate attempt from the same starting position.

introduction: A squad tests a light mortar's minimum range. Two stacked leaders compare a lone SMC's light-mortar reading of the 81mm with the pair's Gun reading and Multiple ROF.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
